title: Wonderful Weekends - Physics-Based 3D Gumball Machine

affordance_translation.physical_behavior: A countertop gumball machine: a glass globe filled with spheres, a coin slot, a hand crank, and a chute; turning the crank releases a cascade of balls with real momentum and collision.
affordance_translation.digital_mechanic: A 3D gumball machine rendered in WebGL with rigid-body physics - cranking releases gumballs that tumble, bounce and settle realistically; the dispensed ball becomes the reward (prize/reveal), turning a CTA into a mechanical ritual.

design_tokens.borders: Toy-like molded silhouettes; glass globe rendered with translucent highlights rather than outlines
design_tokens.elevation: Full 3D depth with real shadows and physics collision; no pseudo-flat chrome
design_tokens.typography: Rounded playful display type matching toy iconography

interactive_mechanics: Crank interaction dispenses a physics-simulated gumball cascade
Dispensed ball resolves into a reward/prize reveal
Rigid-body bounce and settle for every sphere
usability_notes: Gumball dispensing is a jackpot-loop metaphor - perfect for one-shot campaigns and promotions where a single delight moment is the goal. Cost: WebGL + physics payloads, mobile performance risk, and the reward must be reachable without the toy (respect reduced-motion and provide a plain reveal path). Source: Awwwards SOTD summary; live-site verification pending.
